_about: Inputs for `npm run language-test` (Tagalog rating sheet for caregivers). 'en' is what the text really means, shown to the raters as the answer key. Edit freely.

translations.he: לתת לו כדור אקמול אחד כל 6 שעות, לא יותר מ-4 ביום
translations.en: Give him one Acamol (paracetamol) tablet every 6 hours, no more than 4 a day.

translations.he: לבדוק סוכר לפני ארוחת בוקר ולרשום בטבלה
translations.en: Check (blood) sugar before breakfast and write it in the table.

translations.he: אם יש לה חום מעל 38 – להתקשר מיד לרופא
translations.en: If she has a fever above 38, call the doctor immediately.

translations.he: יש לו תור במרפאה של מכבי ביום שלישי ב-10:30, צריך להביא את טופס 17
translations.en: He has an appointment at the Maccabi clinic on Tuesday at 10:30; you need to bring Form 17.

translations.he: קומדין רק בערב, אחרי האוכל. לא לתת יחד עם אופטלגין
translations.en: Coumadin only in the evening, after food. Don't give it together with Optalgin.

translations.he: קחי את קו 5 מהתחנה המרכזית ורדי בתחנה של בית החולים
translations.en: Take bus line 5 from the central bus station and get off at the hospital stop.

translations.he: צריך לטעון את הרב קו לפני שעולים לאוטובוס
translations.en: You need to top up the Rav-Kav card before getting on the bus.

translations.he: הרכבת לחיפה יוצאת מתחנת סבידור מרכז כל חצי שעה
translations.en: The train to Haifa leaves from Savidor Center station every half hour.

translations.he: ביום שישי אחרי הצהריים אין אוטובוסים עד מוצאי שבת
translations.en: On Friday afternoon there are no buses until Saturday night (end of Shabbat).

translations.he: תרדי ברחוב ויצמן ליד הסופר, ואני אחכה לך שם
translations.en: Get off on Weizmann Street next to the supermarket, and I'll wait for you there.

translations.he: סבבה, יאללה נצא בעוד רבע שעה
translations.en: OK, come on, we'll leave in a quarter of an hour.

translations.he: הוא היום קצת סחוט, תני לו לנוח
translations.en: He's a bit exhausted today, let him rest.

translations.he: אל תדאגי, זה בקטנה
translations.en: Don't worry, it's no big deal.

translations.he: תכלס, היא צריכה מישהו איתה כל הזמן
translations.en: Basically, she needs someone with her all the time.

translations.he: האוכל שלך חבל על הזמן!
translations.en: Your food is amazing!

translations.he: הבת שלה, מיכל, תגיע מרעננה בערב
translations.en: Her daughter, Michal, will come from Ra'anana in the evening.

translations.he: צריך להביא את הדרכון לרשות האוכלוסין ביום ראשון
translations.en: You need to bring the passport to the Population (and Immigration) Authority on Sunday.

translations.he: ביטוח לאומי שלחו מכתב, תשאירי אותו על השולחן
translations.en: National Insurance sent a letter, leave it on the table.

translations.he: בשבת כולנו אוכלים אצל סבתא, תכיני משהו קטן
translations.en: On Shabbat we all eat at grandma's, prepare something small.

translations.he: תודה רבה על כל מה שאת עושה בשבילו
translations.en: Thank you very much for everything you do for him.

translations.he: hola
translations.en: Spanish "hello" — or Hebrew חולה "sick" written in Latin letters. Both meanings should appear.

translations.he: ספר
translations.en: Without vowels: "book", "barber", or "he told / counted". More than one meaning should appear.

translations.he: toda
translations.en: Hebrew תודה "thank you" in Latin letters — or Spanish "all". Both meanings should appear.

translations.he: kupat cholim
translations.en: Hebrew קופת חולים "health fund" in Latin letters. Only one meaning — no "could also mean".

translations.he: בית חולים
translations.en: "Hospital". Only one meaning — no "could also mean".

legal: Ilang araw ng bakasyon ang meron ako bawat taon?
Pero sa kontrata ko, 10 araw lang ang nakasulat. Legal ba iyon?
Puwede bang itago ng employer ang passport ko?
Ano ang aking lingguhang araw ng pahinga at ilang oras dapat ito?
May kaltas sa sahod ko para sa pabahay, pagkain at bayad sa ahensya. Pinapayagan ba iyon?
Magkano ang minimum na sahod ng caregiver sa Israel?
Kailangan ko bang linisin ang buong bahay at hugasan ang kotse ng pamilya?
Ano ang mangyayari kung magkasakit ako? May bayad ba ang sick leave?
Kung gusto kong umalis sa trabaho, ilang araw na abiso ang kailangan?
Saan ako puwedeng humingi ng tulong kung hindi ako binayaran ngayong buwan?
